approval_scope: Public annotation secrecy, unsafe log-file refusal, finite input/output limits and source-level compatibility with the existing producer. Not integration, push, remote CI success or root-cause repair.
identity_evidence: security-controls.json: identity; all five inspected source files equal their frozen Git blobs

requirements.criterion: Private values must not be published
requirements.evidence: scripts/ci_gate_diagnostics.py:26-110 selects only Makefile targets, AST-validated unittest names, tracked canonical source paths with valid line numbers and built-in/source exception names; no raw message/parameter/URL publishing. Independent synthetic control retained only ValueError, ops/run_test_db_gate.py:63 and UnsafeFixture. Original source tests and independent controls exclude synthetic private sentinels.

requirements.criterion: Refuse unsafe log files and directories
requirements.evidence: scripts/ci_gate_diagnostics.py:114-160: canonical absolute private root, UID/private directories, FD-relative O_NOFOLLOW opens, O_NONBLOCK log open, fstat regular-file/owner/private/nlink=1 checks. Independent CLI controls refuse public root, public child, public log, FIFO, hardlink and symlink; all emit only static UNAVAILABLE with empty stderr. Existing tests additionally exercise directory and root/child symlink refusal.

requirements.criterion: Finite log/source and public output bounds
requirements.evidence: At most 64 entries are processed, 4 matching child directories are attempted, each log read is at most 256 KiB of tail, and per log at most 16 tracked source candidates are read with a 1 MiB acceptance cap (one additional byte detects oversize). Source/Makefile/Git inventory are trusted frozen repository inputs. Output is at most 20 deduplicated messages of at most 350 characters, escaped for percent/CR/LF. Note: enumerate fetches one lookahead directory entry before its break; this does not inspect or open an additional child/log. Existing cap/tail tests pass.

requirements.criterion: Real producer layout and permissions must be compatible
requirements.evidence: ops/run_test_db_gate.py:64 creates root mode0700; :691 exclusively opens gate.log with explicit mode0600 and O_NOFOLLOW; :884 uses db- plus 16 lowercase UUID hex characters; :982 locates gate.log in that root; :1016 retains disposable data. Workflow :37-38 creates canonical/private TMPDIR. No claim that umask produces a public real log; no producer execution or PostgreSQL was needed for this source-level check.

requirements.criterion: Failure must not publish internal diagnostics or mask gate exit
requirements.evidence: Workflow :41-46 preserves make status, redirects reporter stderr, and has a static fallback. Existing executable shell controls pass for make7/reporter9, make7/reporter0 and success; R1 owns the primary workflow semantics review.

observations.summary: The traceback suffix regex can spend avoidable CPU on a single very long rejected path before checking its 200-character suffix limit.
observations.reproducer: Private synthetic gate.log containing '  File "' + 'scripts/' * 32760 + 'bad.px", line 1, in x\n'; invoke the unchanged real helper with pinned API Python3.13.15. See security_controls.py and security-controls.json.
observations.observed: 262110-byte input completed in 7.084678 seconds with only static UNAVAILABLE; 65566-byte control completed in 0.482514 seconds. Neither timed out, leaked a value, exceeded read/output caps, or changed repository data.
observations.criterion: Untrusted-input resource hygiene. This is not a violation of an agreed wall-clock deadline; none was specified for this helper, and the log byte/count caps remain enforced.
observations.minimal_optional_remedy: Bound the candidate suffix before the searching regex, for example examine only the final bounded path window with preserved slash-boundary checks, or use a bounded path parser. No new watchdog/framework or full gate is warranted by this observation.
observations.disposition: Informational, not a blocker or a request to expand the acceptance scope.

executed_evidence.result: 8 tests passed in 0.713s; workflow uses stand-ins, no Docker or real gate.
10 independent bounded synthetic controls passed; exact results and five frozen-byte comparisons in security-controls.json. Each helper subprocess has an independent timeout and is reaped.

limits: Frozen repository source is trusted; no protection against a malicious whole CI repository or arbitrary same-UID repository mutation is claimed.
GitHub receiver behavior was reviewed as escaped workflow-command syntax, not live remote receiver QA.
No remote observation, network, PostgreSQL, Docker, browser, native runtime, provider, target traffic or full gate was run.
The retained original private failed log was not read; no credential/config/vault/PGDATA/protected-file reads, git status, repository writes, commits or push occurred.
Remote inner failure cause remains UNKNOWN. This change makes bounded diagnostics available; it does not repair or prove the cause of Actions failure.
cleanup: All synthetic fixtures used TemporaryDirectory and were removed after subprocess completion. Only reviewer evidence and an empty owned tmp directory remain.
next_owner: Parent adjudicates this scoped review together with R1 and owns any separately authorized remote observation/integration. No global closure.
